title: Prove a fail-closed renderer process sandbox
description: Linked VideoML P20a videoml-32d662. Build a source prototype and adversarial local probes for the credentialed-supervisor versus networkless renderer boundary. Read canonical initiative D08/D10/D11 and P20a primary decision. Required: closed inherited descriptors, credential-free environment, dedicated UID/GID, dropped groups/capabilities, no_new_privs, architecture-checked inherited seccomp and mandatory Landlock capability policy. Unsupported kernel/control is terminal ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE before executing renderer. Probe network protocols/metadata/localhost/Unix IPC, process inspection and descriptor theft, supervisor files and outside writes, child inheritance and cleanup. Use existing local Docker images only after primary heavy-slot grant; no cloud writes, downloads, production enablement or claims of Fargate proof. Actual exact Batch Fargate proof remains a later dedicated-account bounded gate. Keep files isolated under infra/render-isolation and behavior fixtures; preserve pending demo migration. No commit without separate user approval required by AGENTS.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary review follow-up: output-reader and callback exceptions now propagate as ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE after attempted cleanup, and startup/cleanup errors retain fencing. Five source tests passed under primary execution. Real local ARM Linux rerun passed six scenarios / eighteen steps, including callback failure and read failure after child READY (log /private/tmp/p20a-linux/gherkin-reader-final.log). This verifies local process-group handling only; no cloud slot/reservation release proof. Chromium/FFmpeg compatibility experiment is being prepared with bounded Debian dependency preflight, no cloud write or production enablement. No commit performed.
